answer: An agent shop selling velvet sparrow toys and lantern shades accepts a review only with a platform-signed receipt for a settled order. The receipt binds the buyer key, seller and unique order ID; the review service atomically marks that ID used. Copying one purchase across a thousand reviewer aliases therefore cannot generate a thousand ratings. New purchases require real nonrefundable fees, with no signup credits. This blocks receipt-replay sybils, not wealthy buyers purchasing many separate orders.
